free_short: Free to use · works offline after setup
tools_online: Online · field tools can also run offline after setup
tools_offline: Offline · use the field tools without signal
kit_title: Share a small offline field kit
kit_help: Download this self-contained HTML file once and share the file by Bluetooth, USB or a file-sharing app. Open it in a browser that supports local HTML files. It contains basic calculator, symptom and soil tools, with no account or network calls. It does not include the installable PWA, encrypted logbook or cloud backup. File handling depends on the receiving phone and browser; test before distribution.
free_promise: Free to use. Calculator, crop checks and soil guide work offline after first setup. No account needed for these tools.
sample_notice: Sample crop targets for this prototype. Confirm a crop-specific plan with a qualified adviser before applying fertilizer.
purchase_rounding: whole bags to buy, not an instruction to apply every bag
soil_credit_help: Use only the plant-available nitrogen credit in kg/ha supplied by your soil-test adviser. Do not enter raw ppm, total nitrogen or a percentage. Leave at zero if unknown.
cap_title: Measured caps for a small plot (optional)
cap_help: Cap sizes and fertilizer density vary. Weigh the actual product held in your cap, then enter the number of plants receiving this quantity. This converts units only; it does not prescribe a per-plant dose.
cap_missing: Enter plant count and measured cap mass first
formula_help: Product kg = net nitrogen kg/ha × hectares ÷ product nitrogen fraction:
bucket_help: Buckets assume a measured 15 kg of this product, not a 15-litre container.
split_warning: Placement and timing matter: concentrated fertilizer can injure plants. For sandy soil or this high sample nitrogen target, ask an adviser about smaller split applications. This tool does not choose a safe application schedule.
nitrogen_only: This calculation meets a nitrogen target only. It does not balance phosphorus or potassium, and is not a complete fertilizer plan.
diagnosis_notice: Illustrative symptom triage, not a confirmed diagnosis. Different pests, diseases and growing conditions can look alike.
flow_caterpillar: On maize, do you also see caterpillars or droppings in the leaf whorl?
flow_wet: Are leaf patches spreading after wet weather?
flow_old: Are the older, lower leaves affected first?
flow_armyworm_help: Record the affected crop, visible caterpillars and damaged plants. Ask an extension officer to identify the pest before choosing control. Ragged holes alone do not confirm fall armyworm.
flow_blight_help: Record the pattern, weather and spread. Avoid carrying material between fields. Get a crop-specific identification before selecting treatment.
flow_nutrient_help: Record watering, leaf pattern and affected area. Yellow lower leaves alone cannot establish a nitrogen deficiency; soil and crop assessment are needed.
flow_uncertain_help: Keep a field note about the crop, timing and symptoms. Seek an extension officer's assessment. Do not apply a chemical based only on this sample flow.
tank_title: Convert a verified liquid-product label rate
tank_help: Use only when the exact product label specifies mL per litre for this crop and use. This is arithmetic, not a pesticide recommendation. Labels in g/L or rates per hectare need different calculations. Never measure pesticides using guessed bottle caps.
label_required: Follow the exact product label, protective equipment and application restrictions.
soil_intro: Explore soil texture offline. Texture is one part of growing conditions; it does not establish nutrient levels.
soil_sandy_help: Often feels gritty and drains quickly. Ask about nutrient losses and split applications when planning fertilizer.
soil_clay_help: Often feels sticky when wet and holds water. Observe drainage and avoid compacting wet ground.
soil_loam_help: A mixture of particle sizes. Observe moisture and drainage rather than assuming it needs a fixed fertilizer dose.
use_soil: Use this soil type in calculator
jar_1: Collect representative soil; remove stones and large plant material.
jar_2: Put some soil and water in a clear jar, close the lid and shake thoroughly.
jar_3: Leave it undisturbed. Observe coarse material settling first and finer material later.
jar_4: Compare the visible layers for a rough idea of particle sizes. Repeat with soil from other parts of the field.
jar_limit: This is an approximate observation, not a laboratory soil test. It cannot measure available nitrogen or select a fertilizer dose.
offline_sources: This explanation is bundled and can be read without signal.
offline_ready: Offline app files are cached. Test reopening with Wi-Fi and mobile data turned off.
offline_preparing: Preparing offline access. First setup needs a connection and a supported browser.
install_title: Get it once, use it in the field
install_help: Open the HTTPS app while connected and wait for offline readiness. Use the browser's Install / Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone use Share → Add to Home Screen. Open it once before leaving coverage.
distribution_help: A cooperative or extension visit can help with initial setup where connectivity is available; these are distribution options, not partnerships already in place. This PWA does not install through Xender or a copied website folder. Initial download, updates and optional cloud backup can use data.
backup_title: If the phone is lost or destroyed
backup_help: Notes only on this phone can be lost. In the logbook, export an encrypted backup and keep it on a different device. Optional account sync protects only records you choose to share. Restoring them needs your account password and original encryption passphrase.
translation_notice: Four languages are bundled. Existing and new translations need native-speaker review; untranslated guidance falls back to English.
log_free_help: No internet or cloud account is needed to keep notes. Create a local encryption passphrase once and use it to unlock offline. Cloud backup is optional.
local_risk: Keep a backup on another device: phone-only notes cannot be recovered if this phone is destroyed.
